verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs to connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep mail and documents in sync, so a first-party API exists. The evidence is only marketing copy, with no API reference or other signs of a documented public developer surface. Missing for 10: published API reference documentation, authentication and endpoint details, evidence the API is public rather than partner-only, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
API integrations to connect your mailbox with the tools you already use
